ev.q: Of the 31 deaths, 24 (77%) were classified as unintentional injury, six (19%) were attributable to natural causes
As of September 1, a total of 31 deaths had been reported; 12 (39%) occurred on the first day of the storm
Of those 11 deaths, nine were directly related to the storm, and two were indirectly related
Decedents ranged in age from 6 to 87 years (mean: 54 years; median: 56 years)
12 (39%) occurred on the first day of the storm, and eight (26%) additional deaths occurred during the next 2 days
Under Florida law, all deaths related to hurricanes are reportable to MEs
